description: This file contains auto-generated C++ code for tensor variance decomposition functions used in PyTorch's JIT runtime, including function definitions for var_decomposition and var, as well as mappings for tensor operations.

methods.name: GetSerializedDecompositions
methods.description: Returns the serialized string containing the decomposition functions for variance operations.

methods.name: GetDecompositionMapping
methods.description: Returns a mapping between tensor operation signatures and their corresponding decomposition function names.
